components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action. Ink fill, quiet; hover deepens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Adjacent/secondary actions next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0284c7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Parameter and demo-data entry with label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #52525b; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0284c7; }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: Actor, state, and concept tags. Color always means state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #f4f4f5; color: #52525b; } .ds-badge-ok { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; } .ds-badge-err { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; } .ds-badge-info { background: #e0f2fe; color: #0c4a6e; }

components.name: Pane Card
components.description: The three simulator panes and dashboard modules. Flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card-t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.css: .ds-topnav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font-size: 14px; } .ds-topnav a { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; color: #18181b; text-decoration: none; } .ds-topnav a:hover { background: #f4f4f5; } .ds-topnav em { color: #0284c7; font-style: normal; }

narrative.overview: A neutral board with a vivid mechanism. The shell is quiet zinc and white so that color always means state: amber for holds and waiting, green for settled, red for failures, blue for information and selection.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet instruments: restrained controls; the simulation visuals carry energy.
State-colored, chrome-neutral: <=10% accent per screen; rarity is the point.
Mono for machines, sans for humans.
Flat by default: borders and tone separate surfaces; shadow answers hover.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Color always means state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Banner Rule
rules.body: Caution Amber appears exactly once per screen plus transient waiting states.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Machine values are always mono; human prose never is.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: h1-h3 use balanced wrapping; long prose uses pretty wrapping.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only as a response to state.

dos: Do keep accent coverage <=10% per screen.
Do set machine values in mono at 11-12px.
Do use full 1px hairline borders; reserve blue for selection.
Do raise type and contrast in projector mode.
Do keep the amber simulation banner on every screen, exactly once.
donts: Don't clone fintech brands or their UI.
Don't use side-stripe borders on cards or rows.
Don't pair a 1px border with a >=16px soft shadow.
Don't animate layout properties or gate content on reveals.
